questions.stem_text:
Bernstein thought that using 'restricted codes' of language disadvantaged pupils at school
because:

options.A: this pattern of speech made them the target of bullying
options.B: they referred to explicit, context independent meanings
options.C: they prevented children from communicating outside of their peer groups
options.D: they involved short, simple sentences with a small vocabulary

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - they involved short, simple sentences with a small vocabulary

questions.stem_text: The effect of the Internet upon the public sphere has been to:

options.A: repress it, by promoting only the interests of elite groups
options.B: revive it, by reaffirming a commitment to freedom of speech
options.C: reproduce it, by emphasizing face-to-face contact with peer groups
options.D: replace it with a superior form of communication

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - revive it, by reaffirming a commitment to freedom of speech

questions.stem_text: Marx (1844) claimed that capitalism had alienated workers from:

options.C: each other and humanity in general

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - all of the above

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following sociological perspectives views society as a system of
interdependent and coordinated parts?
Which of the following is not a consequence of global tourism?

options.A: decreased rates of prostitution and sex tourism
options.B: developing countries can depend on it as a crucial source of income
options.C: the exploitation of cheap, unregulated labour in poor countries
options.D: we have become more aware of 'other' societies and ways of living

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - decreased rates of prostitution and sex tourism
